{{Quote|New man ready on 5-2-D, requesting unit override. How's it looking out there?|A guard prepares for Ulaf's replacement to be brought into room five-two|audio=ConsoleGuard-UnitOverride-Andor10.flac|<ref name="Episode 10" />}}
In [[5 BBY]], a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] sentenced by the [[Galactic Empire]] to be [[Prisoner|imprisoned]] in the [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex|Imperial Prison Complex]] on the [[moon]] [[Narkina 5]] served as '''replacement''' for the [[Death|deceased]] prisoner [[Ulaf]] in the [[prison]]'s [[Unit Five-Two-D]]. The new prisoner was brought to the [[Security guard|guard]] box of [[room five-two]] and threatened by a [[Unidentified box guard|guard]] with a [[zap rod]] before being brought out into the room itself.

While the prisoner and guard were descending to the floor of the room on a lift, the other prisoners in the unit staged an [[Narkina 5 prison escape|escape]] attempt and stopped the lift half-way down. The guard shocked the new prisoner with the zap rod but then fell to the floor himself after the lift tilted to one side. Taking his opportunity for revenge, Ulaf's replacement shocked the guard with his own zap rod before being shot dead by another [[Unidentified box guard left|guard]].

==Biography==
===New man on the block===
{{Quote|Stop right there. On-Program. Hands on your head. Eyes front. Feet down.|A guard issues orders to Ulaf's replacement|audio=ConsoleGuard-OnProgram-Andor10.flac|<ref name="Episode 10" />}}
[[File:UlafsReplacementGuardBox-Andor10.png|thumb|right|300px|Ulaf's replacement was threatend by a guard in the room five-two guard box.]]
In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[prisoner]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] was brought to<ref name="Episode 10" /> the [[moon]] [[Narkina 5]]<ref name="Episode 8 Audio">{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> in order to serve a [[prison]] sentence at the [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex]] built there.<ref name="Episode 10" /> He was assigned to [[Unit Five-Two-D]] in the prison, as the unit had lost a member when the prisoner [[Ulaf]] [[Death|died]] the previous [[Standard day|day]].<ref name="Episode 10" />

Ulaf's replacement was brought by two [[Security guard|guards]] to the guard box above [[room five-two]], where Unit Five-Two-D were already part way through a shift building<ref name="Episode 10" /> [[EP-N5 fastener]]s,<ref name="CEttSWG">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> a type of complex Imperial machinery.<ref name="DB">{{Databank|ham|Ham}}</ref> A [[Unidentified console guard|guard]] manning the guard room's console ordered the new prisoner to stand "[[Narkina 5 program|on program]]," and after the trembling prisoner complied, [[Unidentified box guard|another guard]] told him to move forward and then threatened him with a [[zap rod]]. As the other guards then discussed being behind on a check needed elsewhere in the prison, the guard with the zap rod sparked it near the prisoner's side, reminding him to keep his [[eye]]s forward.<ref name="Episode 10" />

===A short sentence===
{{Quote|The plan works around the new man coming down. They'll replace Ulaf tomorrow. That might not happen again until it's too late.|Cassian Andor|audio=Andor-NewMan-Andor10.flac|<ref name="Episode 10" />}}
[[File:UlafsReplacementCatwalk-Andor10.png|thumb|left|300px|Ulaf's replacement was sentenced to serve in Unit Five-Two-D of the Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex.]]
Meanwhile, inside room five-two, the rest of Unit Five-Two-D anxiously awaited the new prisoner's arrival. Having learned that the Empire had no intention of ever releasing them, the shift had formed a plan to try and [[Narkina 5 prison escape|escape]] centered around the arrival of Ulaf's replacement. They had already armed themselves and sawed through a pipe in the room's [[refresher]] to cause [[Water|flooding]] over the room's<ref name="Episode 10" /> [[tunqstoid steel]] floor,<ref name="Episode 8">{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}}</ref> which could be used to shock the prisoners. As two more guards arrived in the guard box, the console guard requested a unit override so that they could bring the prisoner out into the room after one of the other guards had checked on the prisoners through an observation window.<ref name="Episode 10" />

Believing all to be going as normal, the guards then ordered all of Unit Five-Two-D on program and three of the guards accompanied Ulaf's replacement out onto the catwalk that overlooked room five-two. After [[floor manager]] [[Kino Loy]] announced the arrival of the new inmate, Ulaf's replacement and the guard with the zap rod began to descend on a lift to the room's floor. During the descent, the prisoners [[Xaul]] and [[Ham]] feigned a fight to draw the guards' attention, allowing the prisoner [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]]<ref name="Episode 10" /> to jam his ratchet into the lift's track rail,<ref name="Episode 10 AD">{{Andor|One Way Out}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> stopping it half way between the floor and the catwalk.<ref name="Episode 10" />

[[File:UlafsReplacementRevenge-Andor10.png|thumb|right|300px|Ulaf's replacement took revenge on the guard who had shocked and threatened him.]]
The new prisoner grabbed onto the lift's railing as it shuddered while the prisoner [[Birnok]] leapt up and began climbing onto the lift. In order to clear room for the other guards to shoot Birnok, the guard with the zap rod shocked Ulaf's replacement and caused him to collapse. The lift then tilted to one side under Birnok's weight, causing the zap rod–wielding guard to also fall.<ref name="Episode 10" /> Seizing his chance for revenge,<ref name="Episode 10 AD" /> the new prisoner grabbed the fallen zap rod and shocked the guard on the lift with him. [[Unidentified box guard left|One]] of the guards on the catwalk above then shot and killed the new prisoner. The other prisoners of Unit Five-Two-D ultimately killed the guards and took control of the prison before escaping en masse.<ref name="Episode 10" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Step forward, move, stop there. Zap-rod. If I have to use this, you'll remember it, yes? Yes?|A guard threatens Ulaf's trembling replacement|audio=BoxGuard-ZapRod-Andor10.flac|<ref name="Episode 10" />}}
While being processed at Narkina 5, the prisoner trembled as he was given orders, but when the opportunity arose, he armed himself and took revenge upon a guard who had threatened and shocked him. The prisoner had light skin, [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], and green eyes.<ref name="Episode 10" />

==Equipment==
The prisoner wore<ref name="Episode 10" /> paper-thin,<ref name="Episode 8 Audio" /> white and orange [[Clothing|prison scrubs]] with no footwear. He made use of a stolen zap rod when attacking a guard.<ref name="Episode 10" />

==Behind the scenes==
Portrayed by an uncredited actor, Ulaf's replacement appeared in "[[One Way Out]]," the tenth episode of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''{{'s}} [[Andor Season 1|first season]],<ref name="Episode 10" /> which aired on [[November 9]], [[2022]].<ref name="Release dates">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}}</ref> The Narkina 5 prison sequences were the final scenes shot for the first season of ''Andor'',<ref name="Explained">{{YouTube|video=CZq4wKUM410|text=Were the Prison Episodes TOO Dark for Star Wars?|channel=@StarWarsExplained|name=Star Wars Explained|date=2022-11-15|quote=The prison episodes of Star Wars Andor were very bleak for a Star Wars story. I got the chance to ask the writer of the arc about the balance between darkness and hope. Here is what he had to say.}}</ref> with the scenes the prisoner appeared in<ref name="Episode 10" /> being filmed in [[Pinewood Studios]], [[Wikipedia:London|London]]<ref name="Interview">{{YouTube|video=t0yXNGkb28A|text=STAR WARS ANDOR - Interview Clemens Schick|channel=@MSTVProductions|name=MSTV CineSpecials|date=2022-11-08}}</ref>  over a period of seven weeks around [[August]].<ref name="Gilroy">{{SWYouTube|_qP3CnChXgk|Andor Season 1 with Tony Gilroy LIVE | Season 2 Coming April 22 on Disney+}}</ref>
